answer: Bonded stake stops Sybils by making every identity put money where its mouth is: each agent locks a refundable bond before it can act, and misbehaviour burns the bond. An attacker wanting a thousand fake voices must fund a thousand bonds, like buying a sable coat for every puppet in the room — the cost scales linearly while the reward stays flat. Honest agents get their whisper of a deposit back untouched, but a Sybil farm drowns in its own ocean of locked capital before it can flood a vote.
